title: Improve turn-summary precision for ambiguous watcher removals and renames
outcome: Turn summaries distinguish ambiguous covering notifications from confirmed file edits, removals and recreations, preserving conservative notification coverage and useful navigation for confirmed surviving regular files.
acceptance: Confirmed regular-file changes retain useful summary classification and navigation, while ambiguous subtree changes are described truthfully.
Regressions cover Windows-shaped Remove(Any), delete/recreate and rename-into-place without losing covering notifications for real directory removals or renames.
